text:
Sam (release-ops): deploybot alerted p95 and error spike on /v2/generate at ~21:04 UTC. It suggests an automated partial unpin back to v2.3.3 or full rollback to v2.3.2. Observed 30s tails and intermittent 502s in traces.
deploybot: Automated recommendation -> staggered-unpin to v2.3.3 at 10% initial traffic OR full-rollback to v2.3.2. Trigger: p95 > 1200ms for 3 windows and 502 rate > 1%.
Lee (oncall): Is KV-cache suspected? Any quick readouts?
Mika (infra): KV miss rate spiked ~12% at the same time window. I can flip read-through routing for a subset, takes ~3m to propagate.
Jordan (sre): Error budget alarm fired: 502s jumped 0.2% -> 1.8% over 10m. This looks like more than latency noise.
Sam (release-ops): We have three paths: 1) execute deploybot's staggered partial-unpin to limit blast radius, 2) manual full rollback of the pinned bundle now, 3) wait for infra toggle to show effect. Need a decision and comms plan.
Priya (pm): If we roll back, CS needs a short blurb. If partial-unpin, include a release-note line. Carmen can craft.
Carmen (prod-comm): Draft status: "We observed degraded generation latency affecting a subset of requests; routing adjustments and a temporary rollback are in progress to restore service levels. Dedicated customers will receive direct notices if impacted." Will finalize after we pick approach.
Lee (oncall): I'm +1 for partial-unpin 10% -> observe 5m -> ramp if stable, else full rollback. I can approve manual progression.
Sam (release-ops): I'll run staggered unpin. Command to execute: ```/deploy unpin --service inference --from v2.4.0 --to v2.3.3 --pct 10 --strategy staggered --reason "p95 latency spike"```
deploybot: Acknowledged. Initiating staggered-unpin 10% to v2.3.3. Will report step completions.
Mika (infra): I'll apply KV routing toggle on 20% hosts in parallel. If the unpin slice recovers and KV toggles warm, we should be fine. If no improvement in 8m, fallback to rollback.
Jordan (sre): Dashboards: https://graf.redwood/p/abc123. I've set a watch to ping this thread on >1% 502s.
Sam (release-ops): Notifying support and sales. Carmen, prep CS template and post initial customer note at 8m if we haven't escalated.
Carmen (prod-comm): CS template queued. ETA for first public update: 8m. :writing_hand:
Lee (oncall): If 502s stay >1% after initial ramp, I want manual full rollback authority delegated to release-ops.
Sam (release-ops): Copy. Executing now. Progress updates in this thread.
deploybot: Step 1 complete: 10% traffic rerouted to v2.3.3. Observability window started.
Jordan (sre): Early signal: p95 on the unpinned 10% slice down ~18%, overall 502s down to 0.9%.
Sam (release-ops): Good early sign. Continue monitoring.
Mika (infra): KV toggle halfway across targeted hosts, cache warming artifacts visible but not causing errors.
Sam (release-ops): If stable at 5m, we'll ramp another 40% per plan. Else we'll run full rollback: ```/deploy rollback --service inference --to v2.3.2 --reason "persistent latency/regressions"```
Priya (pm): Add quick changelog line: "Traffic-side rollback to stabilize generation latency" and notify product stakeholders.
Carmen (prod-comm): Preparing status message for release notes and support snippet. Will push after confirmation.
Lee (oncall): Keep this thread as SOF for exec steps. Any exec must be posted here with exact command.
Sam (release-ops): 18m update: metrics held stable after ramp to 60% — p95 within SLO and 502s back to baseline. Will continue gradual ramp to 100% and monitor.
Jordan (sre): Confirmed: p95 and 502s stable for 30m on updated split.
Mika (infra): KV routing rollback toggle remained in place; investigating why miss rate jumped initially.
Sam (release-ops): Closing the active mitigation: continue monitoring and prepare postmortem if root cause != KV behavior. Owners: Sam, Mika, Jordan.
Carmen (prod-comm): Sent external update to affected customers. Draft incident summary ready.
Priya (pm): Requesting postmortem and impact assessment on any committed model bundles.
deploybot: Incident ticket auto-created: INC-2026. Follow-ups scheduled for postmortem owners.
